This project will fully renew the Borough Hall 4/5 station and make it fully accessible. projects.description: The project will undertake a feasibility study and other planning and design efforts for improvement of the interconnection between the Sutphin Boulevard/Archer Avenue/JFK Airport subway station, located on the Archer Avenue line in Queens, and the adjacent LIRR Jamaica Station and JFK AirTrain facilities. Improvements to be considered include the addition of elevator/escalator vertical circulation capacity, replacement/upgrade of some station finishes, and system enhancements. Schedule dates are not available, due to project being under development.
projects.title: Planning & Engineering Study At Sutphin Blvd-Archer Av

projects.description: The MTA is committed to ensuring customers feel comfortable and safe as they wait for their train. The 2025-2029 Capital Plan will keep stations open, safe, and accessible by replacing deteriorated platforms and canopies, making targeted structural component upgrades, replacing older elevators and escalators, and expanding accessibility with the installation of new ramps and elevators. This page represents candidate locations identified in the 2025-2029 Capital Plan and is not a comprehensive list of locations within this element. As projects are developed and awarded, locations may change and additional locations may be identified.
projects.title: 25-29 LIRR Station Projects

projects.description: The MTA is committed to improving transit access for everyone, including customers with disabilities, people traveling with children in strollers, seniors, and more. With the 2025-2029 Capital Plan, Metro-North will continue to add elevators, ramps, and create accessible routes between platforms to make full-service stations in Metro-North-operated territory fully accessible, where feasible. This page represents candidate locations identified in the 2025-2029 Capital Plan and is not a comprehensive list of locations within this element. As projects are developed and awarded, locations may change and additional locations may be identified.
projects.title: 25-29 MNR ADA

projects.description: The MTA is committed to improving transit access for everyone, including customers with disabilities, people traveling with children in strollers, seniors, and more. The 2025-2029 Capital Plan will replace at least 45 elevators and 43 escalators across the subway system to make them more reliable for riders. This page represents candidate locations identified in the 2025-2029 Capital Plan and is not a comprehensive list of locations within this element. As projects are developed and awarded, locations may change and additional locations may be identified.
